# Best Case Studio

> Best Case Studio is a two-person studio (Jon McGreevy and Jessie McGreevy) that produces customer case studies for B2B SaaS companies. Two productised offers: Optimise ($750) and Build ($2,500). Turnaround is 14 business days.

## Two ways to work together

### Optimise — $750 per case study

For case studies that aren't earning their place on your website. We audit an existing case study against the Citable Case Study format, rewrite it across all four structural layers (Atomic Answer, Stakeholder Narrative, Evidence Layer, Structured Data), supply the JSON-LD schema markup, and deliver as clean markdown. One consolidated round of revisions.

### Build — $2,500 per case study

Full case study production from scratch. Includes:

- 30-minute customer interview, recorded on Riverside. We schedule it.
- Written case study, 800–1,200 words.
- PDF version for sales use.
- 90–120 second highlight video, edited.
- Three quote graphics for social.
- One launch LinkedIn post, written for the client to publish.
- Two pull-quote excerpts ready for sales decks.
- One consolidated round of revisions after first drafts.

## Who we are

- Jon McGreevy — founder and lead. Seven years working with B2B SaaS on positioning, content, and conversion. Runs every interview, writes every word, edits every video. Writes about trust and credibility in B2B SaaS at https://jonmcgreevy.com and https://jonmcgreevy.substack.com. Hosts the "SaaSy as F**k" podcast.
- Jessie McGreevy — operations. Scheduling, logistics, customer-side coordination, on-time delivery.

No outsourcing, no AI-generated content. The two people you meet on the discovery call are the two people who deliver the work.

## Who it's for

- B2B SaaS companies who want named-customer case studies. Any geography.
- Founders, marketing leads, and sales leaders who want a productized service rather than a quarter-long agency engagement.

## Who it's not for

- Pre-product-market-fit startups without paying customers.
- Companies who want anonymous/persona-style case studies.
- Buyers expecting AI-generated content.

## Pricing

- Optimise: $750 USD per case study. Rewrites an existing case study into the Citable Case Study format.
- Build: $2,500 USD per case study. Full production from customer interview to final deliverables.
- Volume discounts on three or more.
